approvedDesignText:
Add repeatable `--field <name>` and repeatable `--field-id <id>` flags to `gh project item-list`. They are mutually exclusive: supplying both fails before API requests with a clear flag-validation error. Repeating either permitted flag retains every occurrence and its order, including duplicates, producing repeated columns. Command help includes a realistic repeated-name example:

```text
gh project item-list 1 --owner "@me" --field Status --field Priority
```

With no selection flags, item-list preserves its current requests and output. With selections, use the field metadata returned by the normal ProjectItems request first. If that fields connection has more pages, fetch only the remaining field pages and combine them with the already returned page, then resolve against the complete list. Do not make any field-pagination request when selections are absent, and do not duplicate the already available first field page as a preflight request.

For table output, retain Type, Title, Number, Repository, and ID unchanged, then append one requested field column per flag occurrence. Each header uses the resolved field’s canonical name. Resolve names case-insensitively and IDs exactly. An unknown name fails with a deterministic sorted list of available field names. An unknown ID fails with a deterministic sorted list of available `name (id)` pairs. Ambiguous names fail with deterministically sorted matching IDs and `--field-id` guidance. Resolution completes before rendering so no partial or incorrect table is emitted.

For every item, map returned field values to requested columns exclusively by the resolved field ID, never by field name or response position. For each requested column, look up that ID independently; an absent value produces an empty cell in that exact column and cannot shift any following value. Repeated requested IDs therefore read the same ID independently into their respective ordered columns.

Render present values as readable text: date/text/single-select directly; numbers with compact decimal formatting that avoids forced trailing zeros; iterations and milestones by title; labels, users, reviewers, and linked pull requests as comma-and-space lists (label names, user logins, reviewer user logins/team names, and pull-request URLs respectively); repository values as returned URLs. Remove carriage returns and replace line feeds with spaces in every added-column cell value before rendering. Unknown variants render as empty cells.

Selection flags are table-only and conflict clearly with `--format`, avoiding silently ignored column requests. Add tests for parsing/mutual exclusion, help example, complete field pagination only when selected, ordered duplicate columns, case-insensitive resolution, deterministic actionable missing/ambiguous errors, ID-based value-to-column mapping with missing intermediate values, all value formatting and normalization, empty values, formatted-output conflict, and unchanged default behavior.
